methods.label: Recall the correlation bounds
methods.explanation: When both variables have nonzero sample variation, the sample correlation coefficient satisfies \(-1\le r\le 1\). \(r=1\) indicates perfect positive correlation, \(r=-1\) indicates perfect negative correlation, and \(r=0\) indicates no linear correlation. Thus the range is \([-1,1]\), choice B.
methods.levelReason: Recognizing the inclusive bounds is a basic property of sample correlation in the stated elective statistics scope.
